identity_domain.description: Business-code domain shared only when independent evidence proves identical meaning across sources.
identity_domain.title: Identity Domain

entity_kind_hint.description: Business entity type identifier from the goal or semantic schema, not a column role or source value. New types require a definition; naming a type does not confirm it.
entity_kind_hint.title: Entity Kind Hint

ConceptComponent.description: One declared concept; definition identity is independent of row context.

role.description: Stable business role within this joint context, for example metric, product or channel; unique among components. This is not the column-role enum. Do not put row values or combined labels here. Role and definition_ref distinguish concept identities.
role.title: Role

entity_kind.description: Registered business type of this independent concept, distinct from the joint-context type. It must preserve the definition grain; a repeated name alone does not prove that two business definitions are the same.
entity_kind.title: Entity Kind

column.description: Issued column ID in an Agent proposal; authorized physical column name in a compiled rule. Prefer a separate concept column. This column supplies the concept value, not the identity of the full source row or path.
column.title: Column

key_column.description: Independent business-code column for this concept. When present, identity uses this code and column supplies only the label. Same labels with different codes remain different objects. Null retains the explicitly declared value identity.
key_column.title: Key Column

namespace_columns.description: Null inherits the joint-context namespaces. An explicit subset selects this concept identity scope; [] permits cross-context reuse only with scope_evidence_ref. Source support permissions still follow the original row context.
namespace_columns.title: Namespace Columns

scope_evidence_ref.description: Issued document section establishing the narrower concept identity namespace. Required whenever namespace_columns differs from the joint-context scope.
scope_evidence_ref.title: Scope Evidence Ref

definition_ref.description: Issued definition-section reference exactly as doc_id@revision:section_id. It must define this concept and its grain; never use a bare name, invented reference or sample value. Different definitions must not share identity merely because labels match.
definition_ref.title: Definition Ref

identity_domain.description: Optional explicitly verified business-code domain shared with other entity rules. Requires key_column and identity_evidence; the same type, domain, namespace values and code then identify one object across tables. Null keeps definition-local identity.
identity_domain.title: Identity Domain

identity_evidence.description: Issued document-section references proving this code belongs to identity_domain. Equal labels or overlapping codes alone do not establish a common code domain.
identity_evidence.title: Identity Evidence

relation.description: Registered relation from the joint-context entity to this concept type. Preserve the source item binding so separate product and channel edges do not invent combinations.
relation.title: Relation

delimiter.description: Null for a separate concept column. Otherwise the exact literal separator explicitly supported by the cited document, never guessed from punctuation. Declare position and segment_count together. No regex, trimming or implicit fallback is applied.
delimiter.title: Delimiter

position.description: Zero-based segment position established by the cited definition. Required only with delimiter and segment_count; must be smaller than segment_count. Null for a separate column.
position.title: Position

segment_count.description: Exact total number of segments established by the cited document. Every projected value must have this count and nonempty segments; mismatches fail validation instead of guessing a different split. Null for a separate concept column.
segment_count.title: Segment Count

ConceptComponent.title: ConceptComponent

evidence_ref.description: Issued document version exactly as doc_id@revision, without section suffix. The document must support decomposing this source into independent concepts and retaining their joint binding; any delimiter, segment order and grain require explicit evidence. The reference alone grants no semantic approval and must remain a rule dependency.
evidence_ref.title: Evidence Ref

components.description: Independent concepts assigned together by one source-item context. Each component needs its own role, definition and permitted context-to-concept relation. Do not encode the whole product/channel/metric combination as a single concept identity.
components.title: Components

entity_kind_hint.description: Registered type for the joint context, distinct from every concept type.
entity_kind_hint.title: Entity Kind Hint

ConceptMappingSpec.description: Explicit semantic declaration, never inferred from punctuation alone.

evidence_ref.description: Issued document version exactly as doc_id@revision, without section suffix. The document must support decomposing this source into independent concepts and retaining their joint binding; any delimiter, segment order and grain require explicit evidence. The reference alone grants no semantic approval and must remain a rule dependency.
evidence_ref.title: Evidence Ref

components.description: Independent concepts assigned together by one source-item context. Each component needs its own role, definition and permitted context-to-concept relation. Do not encode the whole product/channel/metric combination as a single concept identity.
components.title: Components

ConceptMappingSpec.title: ConceptMappingSpec

identity_domain.description: Business-code domain shared only when independent evidence proves identical meaning across sources.
identity_domain.title: Identity Domain

entity_kind_hint.description: Business entity type identifier from the goal or semantic schema. New types require a definition; never replace business meaning merely to satisfy the schema.
entity_kind_hint.title: Entity Kind Hint

column_id.description: Issued column reference, not a sample value or invented field name.
column_id.title: Column Id

role.description: Column function from this enum, not a business object type: identity_code identifies an object; label names it; semantic_attribute supplies a registered property; fact_value is an observation. Do not translate or invent role values.
role.title: Role

property_name.description: Property identifier from the semantic schema. A new property needs an explicit compatible definition; a source value or display label is not a property identifier.
property_name.title: Property Name

PacketToolObservation.description: Bounded query evidence for this discovery/review call; never persisted.
PacketToolObservation.title: PacketToolObservation

ProposalRepair.description: A rejected schema-only proposal and a compiler-issued repair instruction.
ProposalRepair.title: ProposalRepair

source_entity.description: Verified source entity rule ID from entity_bindings.
source_entity.title: Source Entity

source_columns.description: Issued column IDs on the CURRENT table, ordered to match source_entity key_columns.
source_columns.title: Source Columns

source_level.description: Required selected level for a wide-hierarchy source binding; omit for ordinary groups and long hierarchies.
source_level.title: Source Level

target_level.description: Required selected level for a wide-hierarchy target binding; omit for ordinary groups and long hierarchies.
target_level.title: Target Level

target_columns.description: Issued foreign-key column IDs on the CURRENT table, ordered to match target_entity key_columns. Do not use remote-table IDs.
target_columns.title: Target Columns

allow_self_links.description: Whether an object may relate to itself. False unless explicitly permitted by the business meaning and independently reviewed; matching endpoint values alone never grant this permission.
allow_self_links.title: Allow Self Links

identity_resolution.description: Optional explicit identity policy: source_scoped for legacy paths, verified_identity_domain for relative_path. namespace_local limits namespace values within a verified domain and is not source isolation. Unsupported or inconsistent policies require proposal repair and independent semantic review.
identity_resolution.title: Identity Resolution
